# Race-detector shards of the CI `race` job (`go test -race`), read by
# race-shard.py. Under a "[N]" header, one entry per line:
#
#   ./pkg                 the package's tests
#   ./pkg -run <regexp>   the package's tests that <regexp> selects
#   ./pkg -skip <regexp>  all the others: a package split in two lists both
#                         halves, with the same regexp, in two shards
#   *                     every package of `go list ./...` no line names
#
# A shard starts its packages in the order written, so the slowest come
# first (a slow package started late is what bounds a shard); the packages
# "*" takes follow in `go list` order. A package named twice (other than the
# two halves of a split), a split whose halves differ, a package that does
# not exist or an empty shard fails the job. The comments are race run
# times measured with 4 CPUs (seconds).

./internal/languages/golang -run ^TestFidelity_RepositoryReferencesMatchGoAST$  # 78
[2]

./internal/languages/typescript                                        # 102
./internal/languages/golang -skip ^TestFidelity_RepositoryReferencesMatchGoAST$ # 82
./internal/tsparse                                                     # 32
./internal/index                                                       # 4
[3]
./internal/golden                                                      # 79
./internal/completion                                                  # 59
./internal/languages/php                                               # 30
./tests/integration                                                    # 21
